Clara (CSM): HelixAI reported morning p99 spikes from ~260ms to ~720ms on hosted gen endpoints. Most queries 120-300 tokens, but analytics tasks hit 800-1.1k. Proposing a conservative plan: scoped int8 canary for intake endpoints + token-length routing for long chains + a short prefix warm-up before peak. OK to proceed?
Tom (Solutions Eng): Yes. Two-step canary: internal 5% synthetic (6h) -> 10% customer intake (48h). Route requests with tokens>512 to fp16 variant to avoid drift. Recommend prefix-cache TTL=30s and warmup job 10min before peak.
Ava (Onboard PM): Ill set a 20-min prep call with HelixAI and confirm which endpoints are safe to route. Also will attach a 100-prompt golden eval to run every 4h; auto-revert if semantic accuracy delta >1.5% or error rate +0.5%.
Morgan (HelixAI): Thanks Clara. Intake/bulk-analytics ok to try; keep billing/docs on baseline model. Need rollback within 5 minutes on any errors. Finance wants expected savings estimate.
Tom (Solutions Eng): Ballpark: int8 compute ~30-35% lower; with prefix caching tail cost on routed traffic could drop ~35-45%. Will produce a short conservative estimate.
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: helixai-int8-canary -> 2026-04-12T15:00Z, rollout plan: 5% internal -> 10% customer. Monitoring hooks: latency, errors, semantic-eval.
